notes.title: Balance Patch~
notes.notes:
Finally most of the bugs have been ironed out, a few typo's were also removed but now we have some balance patches, and these are what to expect going forward hopefully~

[list]
[*] Street punk fight reduced to 3 punks and not 4. They also now have a move that burns and not one that poisons.
[*] 
[*] Holy Tablet will also become a move that's a skill, that costs AP, but does MORE damage, and has no downsides to have.
[*] 
[*] Owlburr's have become stronger with a 50% chance to attack twice in 1 turn, along side now knowing body slam.
[*] 
[*] Potions and Tonics can be used outside of combat now and them along side Omega buff no longer fade at the end of combat.
[*] 
[*] Pyre Beetles have a better name now.
[*] 
[*] And finally the mountain Monk boss now is a little stronger and faster, along side a very small chance to counter melee attacks.
[/list]
